arguments:
set -euo pipefail
target="$HOME/rea-final-runtime/bin/rea-mcp"
url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/martaxi-boss/VPS/2457c61763b2114333617e2eda273e46bff7451b/rea-linux/runtime/rea-mcp"
temp="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$temp"' EXIT
curl -fsSL --max-time 25 "$url" -o "$temp"
echo "245bc006ede264724f218df5ba2f65ceead2889067de2342f9b58c48110856c2  $temp" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null
bash -n "$temp"
test -d "$HOME/rea-final-runtime"
install -D -m 755 "$temp" "$target"
test -x "$target"
echo 'REA_PORTABLE_ENTRYPOINT_INSTALLED=pass'
echo "REA_PORTABLE_RUNTIME=$HOME/rea-final-runtime"
